description: Create a Brevo CRM task (POST /crm/tasks). Required: name, taskTypeId (GET /crm/tasktypes via brevo_request), date (ISO). Optional: duration (ms), notes, done, assignToId, contactsIds, dealsIds, companiesIds, reminder.

assignToId.description: ID of the Brevo user the task is assigned to

done.description: Whether the task is already completed

duration.description: Duration of the task in milliseconds

taskTypeId.description: Brevo task type ID (GET /crm/tasktypes via brevo_request)

name: create_brevo_task
